Class MoleculeExaminer

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeExaminer
public final class MoleculeExaminer extends Object
Client-only examination interface for molecules, crystal cells, polymers, and chemical elements, providing interactive 3D inspection, structural details, component breakdowns, and isotope selection.

    • open

      public static void open(MoleculeDef selected)
      Opens the examiner interface for a given molecule definition. Automatically routes polymers and crystal cells to their respective specialized examiners.
      Parameters:
      selected - the molecule definition to examine, or null to abort

    • openElement

      public static void openElement(String symbol, int massNumber, Runnable onReturn, IntConsumer onIsotopeChanged)
      Opens a catalog element with a specified mass number, return action, and isotope change listener.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the chemical element symbol
      massNumber - the specific isotope mass number
      onReturn - the callback runnable executed upon returning
      onIsotopeChanged - the consumer notified when the selected isotope mass changes
